note: INVENTED. ADR-0028 §5: every field whose extraction_method is `llm` renders a visible machine-inferred badge, and a low confidence is displayed rather than used to hide the record (§7). This is the record-side half of catalogue row x-05 — the rendering-side half is fixtures/rendering/rep-05-llm-inferred.json, which is what /dev/components draws. There is nothing to capture here: a low-confidence extraction is a state of OUR pipeline, not a payload any upstream API serves, so the event stream is hand-written. The identity is an ieawind|… source identity on a page path that exists only in this fixture, so no real work is implicated. Two of the three mapped fields came from the model at confidence 0.38 and 0.42 — well under the 0.5 the ADR-0031 queueing path treats as a miss — and the third came from a pattern match, so a reader can see the badge appear on exactly the fields it should and on no others.
